memories.content: The atlas release build gets cancelled by the 30-minute CI timeout because the release job never persists the cargo registry cache between runs, so every build eats an ~18-minute cold-cache penalty that pushes total build time past the 30-minute limit; the fix is to cache ~/.cargo/registry keyed on Cargo.lock between release builds rather than raising the timeout.
